apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial iOS companion reader for a self-hosted BookOrbit server. Library and Browse, an EPUB reader with highlights and progress sync, a reading companion, offline reading and Home Screen widgets.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the BookOrbit project. Free software under AGPL-3.0 with additional terms.
